verses.commentary: Put the trumpet to your lips! Alarm call. An eagle over the house of the Lord. Predator circling. Because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law. The reason for danger stated.
Israel cries out: Our God, we acknowledge you! The right words. But profession without practice. They claim relationship while breaking covenant.
Israel has rejected what is good. The fundamental choice wrong. An enemy will pursue him. Consequences follow.

They set up kings without my consent. Political decisions without God. They choose princes without my approval. Self-appointed leadership. With silver and gold they make idols for their own destruction. Wealth funds idolatry.

Samaria, throw out your calf-idol! The golden calf at Bethel, center of northern worship. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity? The question implies capability exists but is unused.
This calf is from Israel! Home-grown idolatry. A metalworker made it; it is not God. Human product, not divine reality. It will be broken in pieces. The fate of all idols.
They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The proverb. Small causes, large effects. The stalk has no head. Fruitless growth. Even if it yielded, foreigners would consume it. Nothing kept.
Israel is swallowed up. Consumed by nations. Like something no one wants. Worthless among peoples.
They have gone to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Stubborn, directionless, vulnerable. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers. Paying for what costs.
Though they have sold themselves among the nations, I will gather them. God collects what scattered. They will waste away under the mighty king's oppression. Assyria will burden them.
Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings. Religious multiplication. But these have become altars for sinning. The cure becomes the disease. More altars, more sin.

I wrote for them the many things of my law. God's extensive instruction. But they regarded them as something foreign. Strange, alien, irrelevant. The law meant for them treated as belonging to others.
They offer sacrifices and eat the meat. Religious activity continues. But the Lord is not pleased. Ritual without heart. They will return to Egypt. Reversal of exodus. Salvation undone.

Israel has forgotten their Maker. The root problem. Built palaces instead. Judah fortified towns. Both kingdoms trusted in construction. But I will send fire on their cities. Fire consumes fortresses. What they built for security will burn.
